svg.title: STFE 2027 Brand Guidelines — Graphic language
svg.desc: STFE 2027 brand identity. Fonts: Rajdhani and Manrope (Google Fonts, SIL OFL) must be installed for correct text rendering. The STFE 2027 logo is the approved raster artwork embedded unaltered.

text.tspan: Nested exhibition frames converging to a
Three slanted bars for energy and
Isometric cubes, nearly invisible, for light
Rule of one: use one hero element per composition; pair it with photography or a clean field of colour.
